versions.title: Layout + Storage: Footer Rules & Env URLs
changes: Disabled the inner layout footer on /teachertab/* routes to prevent layout overlap and keep those screens focused
Moved Supabase Storage public base URL to .env (VITE_SUPABASE_STORAGE_PUBLIC_URL) and removed hardcoded storage URLs from announcement uploads and answer key image links

versions.title: Student UI: Mobile UX + Answer Sheet Guidance
changes: Added a pre-upload reminders dialog with photo/format tips and sample images
Added fullscreen sample viewer (Recommended / Not recommended), including carousel/slider for examples
Improved AI answer extraction reliability for handwritten sheets (better JSON handling, MIME detection, OCR fallback)
Fixed Student view mobile scroll/layout issues and ensured the footer no longer covers page content
Made the footer compact on mobile by reducing spacing and collapsing the team section

changes: Enhanced item filtering and search capabilities
